posts.en:
dsh-git-hygiene is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Git hygiene checker: read-only scan of merged and stale branches, oversized tracked files, untracked files and uncommitted work, with cleanup suggestions (it never deletes anything).

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-937cbe4420cf73987c2d.html
